entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Ordered composite CREATE INDEX DDL stores durable index element clauses, shared generation ownership, include columns, rebuild requirement, and building lifecycle metadata on every participating relational column. Ready promotion rejects stale generations and preserves the ordered composite key clauses, include columns, generation, and promoted lifecycle in the runtime schema before the planner may trust the access path.
entries.evidence_symbol: catalog apply applies incremental ddl plans to public schema json

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Secondary-index rebuild work ranges are durable, workers can repair and finish ranges, stale ready rebuild generations are ignored during promotion, and generated expression indexes rebuild from materialized typed-row writes before the all-range readiness gate promotes the expected generation through the ordinary secondary-index lifecycle.
entries.evidence_symbol: secondary index rebuild worker rebuilds and promotes expression generated index

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Release-gated storage, schema-job, and typed-row tests prove stale derived artifacts fail closed or stay invisible across query answers, promotion, uniqueness/upsert owner selection, and FK enforcement: building or incomplete secondary indexes scan base rows, ordered indexes remain untrusted, stale ready rebuild generations are ignored, unvalidated unique owners cannot drive upsert conflict selection, and unvalidated foreign keys are ignored for write enforcement until validation promotes them.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query ignores building secondary indexes and scans base rows
